specification.description: Blue faux leather sling bag with a bohemian profile and standard shape, suited to Beach Wedding styling. The softly curved body balances a practical crossbody strap with a polished finish.
construction_details: Curved faux leather body with piped edges
Adjustable crossbody strap with tonal stitching
Top zip closure and rear slip pocket
specification.care_instructions: Wipe clean with a soft, slightly damp cloth and dry immediately. Do not use solvents or abrasive cleaners.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
